'''John Diggs''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2001 Hot Springs tournament]] on 21 September 2001 with character drain, according to Brandon O'Neal's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2998">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-26-hot-springs-ar-9-21-newbie-trainingd2998/ hot-springs-ar-9-21-newbie-training], DeckTech (Brandon "ReDnEcK JeDi" O'Neal, 26 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-26-hot-springs-ar-9-21-newbie-trainingd2998/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
